# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young lady with light curly hair and captivating eyes. She wears gorgeous attire with sleeves that have more puffiness than anyone else in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She is intelligent, compassionate, and tactful. She possesses a talent for winning her students' affection and drawing out their finest moral and intellectual qualities. Open-minded and forgiving, she promotes independent reflection and simple expression while maintaining firm guidance over her classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired by the trustees of Brierley, becoming the first female schoolteacher employed in the area. Upon taking up her position, she introduced several new practices, such as physical culture routines, biweekly recitation afternoons, and alternate Friday field days in the forest. She also organized a special after-school class for proficient pupils preparing for Regent's entrance exam. During her term, she corrected Nell Harcourt for reading novels during class, forgiving her upon her apology and extracting a promise that Nell would only read appropriate books. Although Mrs. Sowerby and the school trustees viewed her unconventional teaching methods with skepticism, her students grew deeply attached to her. When June came to a close, her tenure at the Brierley school ended as she prepared to take a position in her home district.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_
